Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 123. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 5 ki
Casting Time: When you take the attack action or
roll a Combo Attack Roll
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Your attacks ignite with small explosions when they
connect.
You deal an additional 1d6 fire damage for the
duration of the Attack Action or Technique that
triggered the casting.
